quality.review_scope: Complete supplied 10-page main article and matched 17-page SI read and independently audited. Separate canonical/reader, molecular and apparatus audits passed. Two shell-growth routes, eight supporting procedures and eight observation contexts remain distinct. Printed conflicts and unresolved specimen joins are preserved. Precursor crystal coordinates are not CdSe/CdS product coordinates. No new training task or exact structure–recipe pair is admitted.
missing_fields: No complete executable laboratory SOP is asserted.
Upstream NH4PTC and starting CdSe-belt preparations are cited rather than supplied in full.
No supplied CdSe/CdS product atomic coordinates; precursor crystal tables do not establish a product structure.
Physical batch identity is not inferred across TEM, XRD, elemental and optical contexts.
